# Assignment Markdown Guidelines

All assignment markdown files must use the structure defined in `templates/assignment-template.md`.

## Required file format

- Each assignment must be written as a `README.md` file in its assignment folder.
- Do not remove, rename, or skip required sections from the template.
- Keep content clear, concise, and student-focused.
- Do not add extra top-level sections unless the assignment explicitly requires them.

## Template structure

The assignment template uses these exact section headings and icons:

- `# 📘 Assignment: [Assignment Title]`
- `## 🎯 Objective`
- `## 📝 Tasks`
- `### 🛠️ [Task Title]`
- `#### Description`
- `#### Requirements`

## Writing guidance

- Title: Use a short, descriptive assignment name.
- Objective: Describe in 1–2 sentences what students will learn or accomplish.
- Task titles: Use action-oriented names that describe the work.
- Description: Explain what the student should do in plain language.
- Requirements: Use bullet points for expected outcomes, features, or deliverables.
- Include example input/output in fenced code blocks when it helps clarify expected behavior.

## Best practices

- Favor concrete, measurable requirements.
- Use the exact icons and formatting from the template.
- Keep instructions student-friendly and avoid unnecessary jargon.
- Refer to the template for the canonical assignment structure.
